info.name: PDF Knowledge Assistant
info.description: Endpoints for pdf-knowledge-assistant: chat, RAG chat, and URL-based document ingestion.

request.description: Plain chat with the LLM, no retrieval augmentation.

Chat augmented with similarity search results from the vector store. Response is JSON: {"answer": "...", "sources": [{"file": "...", "page": 1, "sourceUrl": "..."}, ...]}. "sources" comes back empty when the model instead ran the ingestUrl tool for that turn.

Downloads the PDF at 'url' and adds it to the vector store. Works for a caller on any machine, since the server fetches the URL itself rather than reading a local path. Refuses private/internal addresses (SSRF guard), caps the download at 25 MB, and checks the downloaded bytes actually start with a PDF's magic header. Citations for these carry 'sourceUrl' in /chat/rag's 'sources'.
